SyncTeX fixture: the first page of `texk/web2c/synctexdir/tests/footest.synctex` from the repository’s pinned TeX Live submodule, with a minimal postamble. No parser code is copied. `source-detection.json` is shared by the TypeScript and Rust tests.

`pdflatex.synctex` was generated by the project’s pdfLaTeX WASM through the public Node wrapper, using the one-line hello document in `scripts/smoke-wrapper.mjs`. It preserves real engine path spellings such as `/project/./main.tex`.
